records.title: PAGEM.MAC
records.use: Guest oracle for paging initialization, CST construction and monitor map management.

records.title: PAGUTL.MAC
records.use: Contains the PGRINI memory scan and MEMOFF recovery path that deliberately handles NXM after the special handler is installed.

records.title: APRSRV.MAC
records.use: Guest oracle for APR conditions, page-fault classification/dispatch, UPT variables and hard-error recovery.

records.title: POSTLD.MAC
records.use: Explains monitor-image relocation before boot. In particular, MOVNRC relocates NRCOD into section 1 and records its postload address in PNRCOD for PGRINI.

records.title: BOOT.MAC
records.use: Guest oracle for memory probing, EXE loading and pre-monitor machine setup.

records.title: STG.MAC
records.use: Use to identify monitor data structures, special PSB/UPT pages and resident variables encountered in traces.
